test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "barriers."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a situation where, when water surpasses its natural obstacles and hits normally dry terrain, a flood happens.
 
• "Barriers" means something that causes problems or makes it impossible for something to happen. (उलझन या रुकावट पैदा करने वाली वस्‍तु; बाधा, व्‍यवधान)
 
 
• Example:* When you live in a foreign country, the language **barriers**__ are often the most difficult problem to overcome.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3."
 
• Correct passage:

A flood occurs when water overflows its natural __**barriers**__ and lands on typically dry ground. Floods have always been an ______ (2) ______ component of life on the planet. A legend about a ______ (3) ______ flood exists in almost every civilisation. Many people have ______ (4) ______ to live near bodies of water in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for drinking, farming, and industry. The majority of the world's major cities are ______ (5) ______ on or near oceans, lakes, or rivers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Looking at other options:

 
 
• **Volumes: **the large quantity or amount of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का बड़ा परिमाण या मात्रा)
 
• **Streams: **the continuous movement of a liquid or gas. (द्रव या गैस का सतत प्रवाह या धारा)
 
• **Currents: **a continuous flowing movement of water, air, etc. (निरंतर बहती जलधारा, वायु आदि; धारा, प्रवाह)
 
 

19c:T10b1,

The correct answer is "unavoidable​."</spa
